lessons: The tectonics recipe uses the default planet body; procedural-world draws the body from the seed, so its tectonics step differs from the module run for seeds whose gravity is not 1.
A world grid of 16 x 8 never leaves the shelf pass after tectonics (createfractal); world_pipeline run refuses fewer than 32 columns.

Mineral tables are written at the end of the run; checkpoints carry the tectonic fields and the snapshot record only.
